dimensions.assessment: Affects all registered lobbyists operating under federal disclosure requirements.
dimensions.evidence: This bill requires registered lobbyists to disclose any foreign countries or political parties

dimensions.assessment: Adds a specific disclosure requirement to existing lobbyist registration forms.
dimensions.evidence: the name and address of each government of a foreign country... that participates in the direction, planning, supervision, or control

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative disclosure modifications with no stated fiscal or spending implications.
Amends a single paragraph of the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995.
dimensions.evidence: Section 4(b) of the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 (2 U.S.C. 1603(b)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to ongoing federal lobbying registration requirements.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill makes a targeted amendment to the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 to require registered lobbyists to disclose foreign countries and political parties directing or controlling their lobbying activities.
